question: Why must revilers of Shiva and the Kula Bhairava be excluded from this transmission?
premises: Slandering the Kula Bhairava is prohibited
The goddess is addressed as witness to this rule
inference: The teaching must not be given to those who revile Shiva or slander the Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may refer to the tradition or its deity.
plain_english: O goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
